svg.title: Permission test matrix for an enterprise RAG pilot
svg.desc: Four personas are tested against five document classes. Executives see the handbook, runbook, and executive memo but not the contractor folder or revoked document. Engineers see the handbook and runbook. Contractors see only the contractor folder. Departed employees see nothing. Any unexpected visible mark is a failed pilot.
svg.text: Four personas, not one admin account.
Ask each persona a question whose answer exists in each document class.

g.text: Any unexpected ✓ is a failed pilot.

svg.text: Run this before the quality demo. A great answer to the wrong person is a breach.
